purpose: Describe actual native correspondence, voting, location and connection changes for already registered legal current-DSTRUCT AC pairs. No new scientific team selection.
case_selection_time: Before examining current-legality-qualified AC outcome distributions
selection_rules: Only equal n and equal m current-label legal AC events; retain original historical identity and current mapping.
Cover the three unordered class pairs where evaluable support exists. Forward and reverse views of one physical pair are one illustration.

For each dominant supported n/m comparison choose an image-near-median positive example and a same-n/m negative or nearzero example when available. Select a physical event near its image mean. Ties use stable event_id lexical order.

Add one equal-node-count large-change case, one difficult/complex-structure case, and one output-state change (including approved manual extension if matched). Roles may overlap; do not fabricate a case to fill an unsupported role.
Cases are post-outcome mechanism illustrations and not an unbiased rate estimate. Quantitative frequency statements use full common-support tables or a separately frozen hash-selected audit sample.
Show every chosen case, including failed mechanism explanations, without replacing unfavorable cases after trace inspection.
fixed_rules: Keep frozen coordinates, references, order policy, threshold, native correspondence and all unselected groups.
At fixed n, the nominal threshold is ceil(n/2), identical in A and C.
Cross-arm linkage uses common D observations keyed by object_id and source_pair_index. Equal local F labels are not cross-arm identities.
A stable native correspondence anchor requires exactly the same nonempty set of common-D observations in one group on each side. Splits/merges and unanchored groups are explicitly flagged.
Vote-threshold crossing on a stable anchor means support crosses the unchanged integer threshold. It does not prove a separately manipulated causal effect.
Native replay is diagnostic acquisition on already computed physical teams; preserve stored outcomes and verify score/status/ERP/topology against them.
Conditional D-only medians hold the full-team group fixed; they are not D-only fusion outcomes.
No custom human connections, coordinate averaging, label changes, scope adjudications, or new Q/T selection.
